now.title: X-Men: First Class
now.text: Angel abandons the young mutants and joins Shaw after his attack on the CIA base. After Shaw dies, she joins Erik's Brotherhood.
cases: FX-010 The Attack on Division X (X-Men: First Class)
FX-011 The Battle of the Cuban Blockade (X-Men: First Class)

proposed.text: Angel abandons the young mutants and joins Shaw when he attacks the CIA base. After Shaw dies, she leaves with Erik.

changes.evidence: X-Men: First Class never uses the name 'Brotherhood' on screen (no occurrence in the film's dialogue); Erik simply leaves with Angel, Azazel, Riptide and Raven. Angel accepts Shaw's offer during the attack on Division X, not after it. The record also names that attack (case FX-010), which happens at the CIA's Division X base, so that place is added beside Cuba.

now.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
now.text: In 1973, Trask's files reveal that Sean was among the mutants Trask captured, experimented on, and killed.

proposed.text: In 1973, Erik names Sean among the mutant brothers and sisters who have died, and blames Charles for not protecting them.

changes.evidence: On screen Erik lists 'Angel. Azazel. Emma. Banshee. Mutant brothers and sisters... all dead! Countless others... experimented on.' Trask's files that Mystique sees show autopsy photos of Angel, Azazel and Emma, not Banshee, so 'Trask's files reveal' Sean's fate is not what the screen shows.

now.title: X-Men: First Class
now.text: Armando joins Charles's recruits, and Shaw kills him by forcing Havok's blast into him.
cases: FX-010 The Attack on Division X (X-Men: First Class)

changes.evidence: Shaw kills Armando during the attack on the CIA's Division X facility (the record's own case FX-010), a clearly located event with no place shown; the app has 'The CIA research base' for Earth-10005.

now.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
now.text: In 2023, the last X-Men hide from the Sentinels in a Chinese temple and send Logan's mind back to 1973.
cases: FX-015 The Fall of the Monastery (X-Men: Days of Future Past)

changes.evidence: This record ends with the X-Men hiding in the temple and sending Logan's mind back; the Sentinels' assault on the temple (FX-015 The Fall of the Monastery) is the next record (k5), which already carries that case.
